tanya: AM async standup — quick update
what I did: landed kernel hotpatch for prefetch, added microbatch latency metrics, ran a 1k-req KV warmup against canary image.
blockers: seeing a 99.9p tail spike when batch_size > 8 (210ms -> 265ms) on short seqs. not sure if it's prefetch overflow or scheduler queueing.
today: iterate heuristics, add eviction traces, run longer tail bench + canary.

rahul: nice. can you paste the exact bench command so I can repro locally?

tanya: sure — used this: 
```
./bench/run --model=gpt-small --seq=128 --batch=1-16 --warmup=200 --rps=50 --prefetch=on
```

sam: heads up — I pushed a small scheduler fix earlier that might affect queueing (@tanya). PR#482. CI green but didn't include long-tail runs.

jess: can infra spin a 3-node canary (2x nvlink each) for a 2h smoke? need to validate p99.9 under steady rps.

bench-bot: perf summary (last run): avg=42ms, p95=120ms, p99=180ms, p99.9=265ms, OOMs=0

rahul: I'll run the bench with PR#482 applied. suggestion: try microbatch timeout=30ms to reduce queue-hopping spikes.

tanya: good call. adding eviction logs for KV to capture miss storms. quick question: if I enable aggressive KV prefetch, does routing still prefer small-batch low-latency path for dedicated customers?

sam: routing logic will prefer small-batch paths when latency SLO is tripped, but Dedicated has slightly looser thresholds. I'll add a canary flag to force small-batch routing for the test.

jess: created infra ticket infra/canary-1723 and allocated nodes. attach your canary config here and I'll provision.

tanya: thanks — config link: https://git.internal/repo/canaries/edge-prefetch-canary.yaml

rahul: code review: looked at tanya's patch, LGTM for logic, left two nits (naming + one docstring).
sam: reviewed scheduler tweak, left one inline question.

tanya: ack — I'll address nits and push an update. planning to flip the canary tomorrow AM and post the run logs here. :thumbsup:

jess: ping if you need rollback hooks or extra telemetry retention.

bench-bot: scheduled long-tail run at 1723457400, will post results to thread when done.
